description: This file defines the PaginationHelper class, which provides utility methods for fetching paginated data from a database using JdbcTemplate. It interacts with database-specific SQL generators and resolvers to perform count queries and retrieve page data.

classes.name: PaginationHelper
classes.description: A Spring component that provides methods to perform paginated database queries, including counting total matching records and fetching items for a specific page.

methods.name: fetchPage
methods.description: Fetches a page of records using a SQL query with arguments, returning a Page object containing the items and total record count.

methods.name: fetchPage
methods.description: Fetches a page of Long-type identifiers from the database, returning a Page object including total count.
